name: Job-targeted résumé review

baseline.Scope: Up to two pages per résumé; one target job posting per review
baseline.Checks: Structure, clarity, bullet impact, formatting, and job-requirement coverage
baseline.Deliverable: Prioritized feedback plus suggested before/after bullet edits in a downloadable report
baseline.Method: AI-assisted analysis; no recruiter or human review promised
baseline.Boundary: No fabricated accomplishments and no interview or hiring guarantee

standout: Each suggested bullet rewrite includes the target-job requirement and the original résumé evidence it uses; missing evidence is flagged instead of filled in.
selling_point: See what each rewrite supports—and where the evidence comes from.

negative_features.comparison: Rezi advertises unlimited resumes; Resume Worded advertises unlimited complete reviews.
negative_features.reason: Deliberate usage cap at a median subscription price.

negative_features.feature: Delivery within 48 hours rather than instant feedback
negative_features.reason: Deliberate service delay; urgent applicants may prefer an immediate tool.

design_notes: $49 is the median of three selected monthly AI-software plans, not a per-review or human-service median. Page limit, deliverable format, cap, and delay are scenario design choices. Job tailoring already exists; traceable evidence is the proposed marketed emphasis, not proven exclusivity.
price_description: $49/month, billed monthly; proposed from selected paid-software median
research_question: Which purchasing situations prefer this offer over alternatives, and does the marketed feature compensate for the deliberate tradeoffs?
experiments: Same offer with versus without marketed standout
Compare by segment without predetermining launch outcome
